body: **Foco:** Verbo-chave: bring.
**Expressões:** to address shortcomings.
**Pronúncia:** Organização da informação pela entonação.
**22 palavras novas** (pensamento crítico).
**Texto do dia:** editorial / opinião.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar bring e seus sentidos (bring up, bring about, bring forward, bring down, bring together, bring to light) num editorial, e dizer to address shortcomings.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Editorial: Bring the Shortcomings to Light
paras: The inquiry **brought to light** serious failures in oversight. Officials **brought up** the issue only after a journalist had asked. Reform will **bring about** change only if the council **addresses** its shortcomings openly.
A new committee **will bring together** experts, residents and critics. Its first meeting has been **brought forward** to Monday. We hope it will not **bring down** the people who speak honestly.

items.q: A committee will bring together several groups.

blocks.body: **bring** + partícula muda o sentido. *Bring up* (mencionar) × *bring up a child* (criar). Aprenda por colocações.

items.s: The report ___ the problem to light. (bring, past)
A committee will ___ together many views. (bring)
The meeting was ___ forward to Monday. (bring, part.)
The council must ___ its shortcomings openly. (address)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: How will we address the shortcomings

body: **to address shortcomings** — tratar as deficiências
**Bring to the table.** — Contribuir com algo.
**Bring home the bacon.** — Trazer o sustento.
**Bring up the rear.** — Fechar a fila.
**Bring the house down.** — Levantar o público.
**Bring someone up to speed.** — Atualizar alguém.
**Bring it on.** — Pode vir.
**Bring to heel.** — Obrigar à obediência.
**Bring a case.** — Mover uma ação.
**Who brought up the issue?** — Quem levantou a questão?
**How will we address the shortcomings?** — Como trataremos as deficiências?
**By bringing together experts and residents.** — Reunindo especialistas e moradores.

head: Phrasal verb
Significado
Exemplo
rows: Don’t bring up the cost. — Não mencione o custo.
Reform brought about change. — A reforma provocou mudança.

items.note: Ênfase intencional: você escolhe qual palavra recebe o acento principal para marcar contraste ou informação nova (nuclear stress).
words: I said it was FLAWED, not false.
It’s the METHOD that is at fault.

prompts.model: Please don’t bring up that topic.
New laws can bring about change.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence editorial using bring in different senses.
blocks.model: The inquiry brought to light several failures. Officials brought up the matter only after a journalist asked. If the council addresses its shortcomings openly, reform can bring about real change. A new panel will bring together experts and residents. Its first meeting has been brought forward to Monday. We hope honest voices will not be brought down.

items.q: What does “bring forward a date” mean?
items.why: **bring forward a date** = antecipar uma data.

items.q: What does “bring up an issue” mean?
items.why: **bring up an issue** = levantar uma questão.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
